This '''Er'stacian soldier''' was a member of a [[Red-armored Er'stacian clan|clan]] of [[Er'stacian]]s whose [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] were distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="PP" /> During a [[Er'stacian clan war|clan war]] sometime between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="time" /> this warrior fought alongside other red-armored Er'stacians versus their rivals, a [[Green-armored Er'stacian clan|clan]] known for its green-armored troops. Both sides wanted possession of the [[Venerable One]], or Megalith, a statue representing the mythical forebear of the Er'stacian [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="PP" />

When the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] [[Mission to Er'stacia|arrived]] on [[Er'stacia]] to negotiate a peace between the rival factions, he quickly called a temporary cease fire. As he negotiated with the clans, this red-armored soldier inadvertently fired a round into the statue and chipped a piece off the Venerable One. The Er'stacian was accused of blasphemy and torn limb from limb. Nevertheless, the incident showed Windu that the two sides held in common their veneration and protective attitude toward the megalith and thus inspired the Jedi Master to slice it into thousands of pieces. This desecration brought peace, as both clans worked together to mend the statue.<ref name="PP" />
